questions.content:
Speaking — Part 1 - Personal information

How do you usually travel around your city or town?
questions.sampleAnswer: I usually travel around my city by motorbike because it is fast and cheap. Sometimes I take the bus when it rains. For short trips, I like to walk or ride my bicycle to stay healthy.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 1 - Personal information

What do you think is the best way to travel around your city? Why?
questions.sampleAnswer: I think the best way to travel around my city is by motorbike. It is very flexible, so I can go almost anywhere quickly. It also saves money on petrol. In the future, I hope we will have more buses and trains too.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 1 - Personal information

Tell me about a place you often visit in your city.
questions.sampleAnswer: A place I often visit in my city is a small park near my house. It has many green trees and a quiet lake. I usually go there in the early morning to walk and breathe fresh air. It is a peaceful place to relax with my family.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 2 - Describe a picture

Describe the picture.
questions.sampleAnswer: In this picture, I can see a father and his young son playing football together outdoors. They are on a big field of green grass, so maybe they are in a park. The father is wearing a casual t-shirt and shorts, and the little boy is wearing sportswear too. There is an orange football on the grass between them. The boy is kicking the ball, and the father is watching him with a big smile. They both look very happy and full of energy. Behind them, there is only green grass, and the weather looks sunny and warm. I think it is a lovely weekend afternoon, and they are enjoying their time together.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 2 - Describe a picture

Tell me about a sport or game you played when you were a child.
questions.sampleAnswer: When I was a child, I loved playing football with my friends after school. We usually played on a small field near my home every afternoon. We did not have a real goal, so we used our shoes to make one. It was simple, but we had so much fun. Those are some of my happiest childhood memories.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 2 - Describe a picture

Why is it good for parents and children to do activities together?
questions.sampleAnswer: I think it is very good for parents and children to do activities together for a few reasons. First, it helps them spend quality time and become closer. Second, playing sports keeps both the parents and the children healthy. Also, children can learn new skills from their parents. Finally, these happy activities create beautiful memories for the whole family.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 3 - Compare two pictures

Compare these two pictures.
questions.sampleAnswer: In the first picture, I can see a man riding a camel in a desert. Behind him, there are the great pyramids of Egypt, so this looks like a hot and dry place for tourists. In contrast, the second picture shows a man driving a horse-drawn carriage. He is wearing a smart suit and a tall top hat, so this looks like an old city many years ago. Both pictures show people using animals to travel. However, the first one is about tourism in the desert, while the second one is about transport in the past. The clothes and the places in the two pictures are very different.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 3 - Compare two pictures

Why do you think people use animals like these to travel?
questions.sampleAnswer: I think people use animals like these to travel for different reasons. In the past, there were no cars, so horses were the main way to move around cities. In the desert, camels are very useful because they are strong and can walk on the sand easily. They can also live for a long time without water. Today, many tourists ride these animals because it is fun and it feels special and traditional.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 3 - Compare two pictures

Some people are worried about using animals for tourism and work. What do you think?
questions.sampleAnswer: I understand why some people are worried about using animals for tourism and work. Sometimes the animals have to work too hard in hot weather, and they may not get enough food, water, or rest. This is not fair or kind to them. I think using animals is okay only if people take good care of them. The owners must give them enough rest and treat them gently. If we cannot look after them well, we should use cars or machines instead.

questions.content:
Speaking — Part 4 - Discuss an abstract topic

I'd like you to talk about a time when you tried very hard to do something. Please say what you were trying to do, why it was important to you, and how you did it.
questions.sampleAnswer:
I'd like to talk about a time when I tried very hard to pass my IELTS exam. It was about a year ago, and I needed a good score to apply for a scholarship. This was really important to me because my family could not pay for university, so the scholarship was my only chance.

To prepare, I made a clear study plan for three months. Every day, I studied vocabulary in the morning and practised listening and speaking in the evening. I also joined an online class and did a lot of practice tests. Sometimes I felt very tired and wanted to give up, but I kept going because I remembered my goal.

After I finished the exam and got my result, I felt extremely happy and proud of myself. I had reached the score I needed, so all my hard work was worth it.

In my opinion, having a plan is very important when you try to do something difficult. A plan helps you use your time well and stay focused. Without a plan, I think it is very easy to feel lost and give up too soon.
